title: Rethinking Semantic Segmentation: A Prototype View (ProtoSeg)
mechanism: Non-learnable multi-prototype classifier: several class centers per class from online clustering; pixels labelled by nearest prototype.
adaptation: Bold bet: 3-5 prototypes for crack, inactive, gridline to hold the five sources' labelling conventions and half-cut vs full-cell appearance as separate modes; 1 prototype for other classes.
min_experiment: Arm: ProtoSeg head on U-Net++ full-res features, 3 seeds; baseline SUP100; metric per-source crack IoU, E1 crack recall, mIoU_rob; kill if no gain >= 0.01 on any primary.
evidence: R: competitive or better mIoU than parametric heads on ADE20K, Cityscapes, COCO-Stuff (abstract level).
